acceptance_predicates.description: Every setup-like and command-owned output destination is classified; eligible missing directories are prepared by ASB while input-only and unsafe paths remain fail-closed.
Human mode emits one concise pre-effect message naming the directory and purpose before creation, while JSON stdout remains machine-only.
Safe missing parents are created with required ownership and mode without asking the user to run mkdir, and repeated execution is idempotent.
Missing input, non-directory, conflict, permission, read-only, symlink, unsafe topology, and replacement cases identify the affected path and remain distinct.
Dry-run performs no mutation; failed preparation does not publish partial configuration/results and cleans only transaction-owned temporary artifacts.

definition_of_done: First-run and repeated setup/project/tool/catalog/plan/run/report/record path journeys pass with clear directory notices.
The positive and hostile filesystem matrix passes with atomicity, mode, symlink, race, cleanup, stream, and JSON compatibility assertions.
Independent review and exact-head hosted checks pass.

inputs.description: AR-1766 fine-grained diagnostic causes and safe path context.
Current ASB configuration, project, tool, catalog, workflow, execution, and artifact destinations.

outputs.description: Safe idempotent directory preparation with created/reused evidence and precise failures.
Concise pre-effect human progress notice for each directory ASB will create.

gates.description: Created, reused, nested, missing-input, conflict, permission, read-only, symlink, race, dry-run, and cleanup cases pass.
Human notices use the diagnostic stream and never corrupt JSON or raw protocol output.
ASB creates only command-owned output directories and preserves trust, ownership, mode, and atomicity boundaries.
